does_not_establish: No claim about end-to-end tokens per second. The deployed Q30 artifact is LOW_FIDELITY and generates degenerate text, so no valid BASE_TRUE_TPS exists to improve yet. The remaining and larger lever, device-indexed expert argument buffers to remove the 48 per-token host route-id readbacks, is designed but not implemented.
finding: Collapsing 64 dispatches from one command buffer each into a single command buffer is a 21.3x reduction, implying roughly 248 us of overhead per command buffer in this microbench. That is the empirical basis for the S-bucket attack: the production path uses 291 cold command buffers (193 vector-decode + 98 structural) with a warm floor of 98, so submission topology - not expert math - is where the recoverable nanoseconds are. Serial single-encoder adds a further ~5%.
